description:
What a task is, and is not, allowed to touch — file-path scope only
in Phase 01 (no code-symbol-level scoping yet). `denied_paths` is
intended to always win over `allowed_paths` on overlap, matching the
fail-closed posture the rest of this codebase already uses for
security-relevant checks (e.g. app/core/security.py's token handling)
— this contract carries that DATA; per hard rule 5, no resolver/
enforcement logic exists in this package yet to actually apply it.

Glob syntax (`fnmatch`-style, e.g. `apps/api/app/services/**`) is the
expected pattern shape; this contract does not itself validate glob
syntax — that's a resolver-time concern, not a schema concern.

allowed_paths.description: Glob patterns this task may create/modify/delete. Empty list means 'no explicit allow-list' — a resolver should treat that as deny-by-default unless deny_by_default is explicitly set False.
allowed_paths.title: Allowed Paths

denied_paths.description: Glob patterns this task may never touch, regardless of allowed_paths. Always wins on overlap.
denied_paths.title: Denied Paths

deny_by_default.description: When true (default), a path matching neither list is denied — fail-closed. When false, an unmatched path is allowed (only denied_paths is enforced).
deny_by_default.title: Deny By Default

max_files_changed.description: Optional cap on distinct file paths touched, independent of BudgetPolicy's cost/time caps.
max_files_changed.title: Max Files Changed

title: ScopePolicy
